h1: SaroRach Pool Villa Resort — private pool + jacuzzi villas that are rare on Koh Larn
intro: Most of Koh Larn is budget guesthouses and small resorts, so genuine private-pool stays are few. SaroRach Pool Villa Resort is one of them — every villa has its own pool with a jacuzzi section and night mood lighting, tucked into a quiet, tree-lined corner near Tawaen Beach. It serves a floating breakfast in the pool and runs free pier transfers · Scored 9.8 from 52 Trip.com reviews, from approx. ฿4,400/night.

Private villa pool with jacuzzi at SaroRach Koh Larn

body.html: SaroRach's selling point is clear from the first photo — every villa has its own private swimming pool, not a shared one. Each pool has a bubbling jacuzzi zone, and at night you can switch on underwater mood lighting, a detail guests mention often in reviews. On an island where most stays are beachside and budget-priced, a pool villa like this is a different kind of choice for travellers who want real privacy.

Room types run from a Pool Villa with a king bed for couples to a Family Pool Villa and a One-Bedroom Villa with a sofa bed for families. Rooms are bright, clean and comfortably sized, and several have a second-floor balcony with glimpses of the trees and sea. Real-guest reviews agree the rooms are very clean and the pools are kept crystal clear.
"Beautiful room, staff very accommodating, floating breakfast was plentiful, very clean pool which has a jacuzzi setting and mood lighting for night time."

Breakfast is served as a floating breakfast — a tray drifts out into your villa pool so you can eat in the water and take photos. Guests love it because it makes the most of the private-villa setting, and portions are generous, not just styled for the camera. Staff earn warm praise for being friendly and quick, and there's a coconut welcome drink at check-in.

On logistics, the resort runs free pier transfers, which helps a lot since hauling luggage around Koh Larn isn't easy. If you want to explore on your own, scooter rental is about 300 baht a day. The villas sit in a quiet, tree-lined pocket near Tawaen Beach, the island's main beach, with Samae Beach about a 16-minute walk away — better suited to slow-life relaxing than to staying right on the sand.

To be honest, SaroRach is not a beachfront stay you can walk straight onto the sand from — its charm is the villas and private pools, not a sea view from your door. If your plan is swimming in the sea all day with the beach at your feet, a true beachfront stay may suit you better. But if the picture in your head is soaking in a private pool, eating a floating breakfast, then riding a scooter to the beaches in between — this delivers it at a more reachable price than pool villas on the bigger islands.

Scores sit very high across the board — 9.8 from 52 Trip.com reviews · Agoda 9.5 · Booking 9.1. Review counts are still modest as it's a newer property, but the praise points the same way: lovely pools, clean rooms, great staff. Over long weekends and Saturdays prices climb fast and villas fill quickly, so book ahead.

honestSummary: SaroRach suits travellers who come to Koh Larn to relax in a private pool villa rather than sleep beside the sea — private pool + jacuzzi in every villa, clean rooms, great staff, and a full floating-breakfast experience · Just accept it's not a walk-onto-the-sand stay and you'll rely on transfers or a scooter to reach the beaches.
honestChecks: If you plan to swim in the sea all day and want to step straight onto the beach — this isn't beachfront, you'll need a ride → a stay right on Tawaen or Samae Beach suits better.
If you're a large group on a tight budget — pool villas cost several times more than the island's guesthouses → plenty of cheaper small resorts exist if savings matter most.
If you're coming on a long weekend or Saturday — villas are few and fill fast, and prices climb → book ahead and lock a free-cancellation rate first.

faqTitle: FAQ — SaroRach Pool Villa Resort, Koh Larn

faq.q: Where on Koh Larn is SaroRach Pool Villa Resort?
faq.a: It sits at 209/66 Moo 7, Koh Larn, Bang Lamung, Chon Buri, in a quiet tree-lined pocket near Tawaen Beach, the island's main beach · Samae Beach is about a 16-minute walk · It's not directly beachfront, but it runs free pier transfers and scooter rental makes the beaches easy to reach.

faq.q: What does SaroRach cost and what room types are there?
faq.a: From approx. ฿4,400/night for a Pool Villa with a king bed · Family Pool Villa and One-Bedroom Villa for families run around ฿5,500–6,500 · Every villa has a private pool + jacuzzi · Prices climb over long weekends and Saturdays, so compare platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does every room really have a private pool?
faq.a: Yes · every villa has its own private swimming pool, not a shared one · Each pool has a bubbling jacuzzi zone and underwater mood lighting at night, the feature guests praise most in reviews.

faq.q: What is the floating breakfast and is it included?
faq.a: A floating breakfast is breakfast served on a tray that floats out into your private pool, so you can eat in the water and take photos · Portions are generous and filling · Some rates include it, others charge extra — always check when booking.

faq.q: How do I get to SaroRach?
faq.a: Take the ferry from Bali Hai Pier in Pattaya across to Koh Larn (about 45 minutes) · Tell the resort ahead to use the free pier transfer · On the island, renting a scooter (about 300 baht/day) is the easiest way to tour the beaches.

Best for couples and small families who want a private pool villa on Koh Larn, focused on relaxing, soaking and photo-worthy stays · Less ideal if you want to sleep right on the beach and step onto the sand from your room, or if you're a large group on a tight budget.
